name: shelf
description: Index your repositories so agents get context on other projects without walking the filesystem. Community schema verified against Shelf 0.4.0. Lookup commands maintain saved state and agent guidance unless --no-refresh is set.

global_args.name: --no-refresh
global_args.description: Use cached state without automatic scanning or agent skill updates.

commands.name: scan
commands.description: Rebuild the index from local roots and GitHub owners. Flags replace the saved roots or owners; without them the saved ones are reused. Reads files only; never runs anything inside a repository.

args.name: --root
args.description: Directory to search for Git repositories; repeatable. Defaults to ~/Development on first scan.

args.name: --github
args.description: GitHub user or organization to list through gh; repeatable.

args.name: --depth
args.description: How many directories deep to look under each root.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List indexed repositories with their descriptions. Creates a missing index or refreshes one older than 24 hours unless --no-refresh is set.

commands.name: search
commands.description: Find repositories by name, description, topic, language, or relation explanations. Maintains the index and agent skills unless --no-refresh is set.

output_fields.name: items
output_fields.description: Matching repositories with id, name, path, remote, and description.

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show one repository: path, remote, branch, language, manifests, agent files, and related repositories. Maintains the index and agent skills unless --no-refresh is set.

commands.name: describe
commands.description: Set or clear a description override that survives rescans.
examples: shelf describe delta "Payments service for the web app"

commands.name: related
commands.description: List repositories related to one, in both directions: those it declares in its .shelf.json, those declaring it, and your local relations. Local relations replace repo-file ones between the same pair. Maintains the index and agent skills unless --no-refresh is set.

commands.name: relate
commands.description: Record a relation on this machine only, from one repository to another. It survives rescans and moves.

args.name: text
args.description: How they relate, from the first repository's side.

examples: shelf relate clip shelf "Uses the repository index"

commands.name: sync
commands.description: Update Shelf guidance for detected Claude and Codex installations and saved custom destinations.

args.name: --skills-dir
args.description: Write and remember this destination instead. Defaults to detected agent directories, or ~/.claude/skills when none are detected.

errors.description: Invalid input, missing index, gh failure, or local I/O failure; read message for remediation.
